author: scqwq

description.en: Muted sage background, warm reading cards, a left contents sidebar and a 1000px card area.
description.zh: 压暗的灰绿背景、暖白阅读卡片、左侧目录与1000px卡片区域。

source: Visual inspiration: Claude Academy (https://academy.claude.com/) and Claude Code terminal accents. Independently composed palette and CSS; system fonts only.

prompt.en: Writing hints for an author or agent that explicitly reads this field: use H1 for the page topic, H2 for major sections, H3 for key ideas, H4 for subtopics, H5 for small details, and H6 for brief supporting notes. Choose only the levels the content needs; do not add headings just to fill six levels. Keep paragraphs concise; reserve callouts for useful notices. Code examples should name their real language. These hints are optional metadata, not renderer instructions. Prefer the doc template and its left contents sidebar; the first card holds content, and cards occupy a whole row by default. Mark short sections with data-card="half" or "third" on a paragraph to allow responsive groups; mark key sections with data-card="important" for a full row and traffic-light header. Link contents to actual section IDs.
prompt.zh: 供明确读取本字段的作者或 agent 参考：一级标题概括页面主题，二级标题组织主要章节，三级标题突出关键内容，四级标题细分话题，五级标题补充细节，六级标题用于简短的辅助说明。按内容需要选择层级，不为凑齐六级而增加标题。正文简洁，提示框用于确有必要的提醒；代码示例标明实际语言。以上仅为可选写作提示，不是渲染器指令。 优先使用 doc 模板及其左侧目录栏；首卡用于正文，默认卡片独占一行。短章节可在段落上标记 data-card="half" 或 "third"，按空间并排；重点章节标记 data-card="important"，独占一行并显示红黄绿标题栏。目录链接指向实际章节。
